a: Funnels measure drop-off across sequential steps (view → signup → pay).
Cohort retention tracks whether groups of users return over time.
DAU/MAU are daily/monthly active users; ratio indicates stickiness.
A north-star metric best captures the core value delivered to customers.
Track product events with properties for analysis (not only page views).
Attribution assigns credit for conversions across channels/touchpoints.
Activation is the moment a new user first experiences core value.
Engagement measures depth/frequency of product use.
Interviews and surveys explain the why behind quantitative trends.
Define hypothesis, metric, sample size, duration, and guardrails before testing.
